From 9.90. euros The homepage also has an agency account, an onward ticket API, an affiliate program and entry-requirement/destination guides. Founded Jun 2026, founder "John". Profit margin 100%.

A pure compliance-paperwork product: border and airline rules force the purchase, and the buyer needs it today. SEO-driven ("onward ticket for Thailand/Philippines"), one-off payments, and it has grown every month since launch. It's tiny for now.

Some airlines and borders want to see that you are flying onward, and buying a real ticket you will not use is a bad trade. Safeonward sells a real reservation you can show, made in a couple of minutes, without the full fare. You pay once per trip. The company is young, and the months have been climbing from a small start.
